container_restart_behavior: Resume from disk without overwriting existing predictions
hash_chain_continuation: Reads last_record_hash from existing predictions.jsonl and continues seamlessly
retroactive_backfill_behavior: Strictly disallowed; downtime bars are recorded as missed in audit log, never retrospectively inferred

atomic_state_refresh: Overwrites current_state.json with verified cumulative counters upon restart
